nodes.label: Main bootstrap
nodes.desc: Entry script of the main process: wires IPC delivery, RPC server, guest views, then loads the app's package.json main script.

nodes.label: Main module registry
nodes.desc: Lazy-loader table of the 40 main-process modules (app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, session, net...).

nodes.label: ipcMain emitter
nodes.desc: Thin factory: one IpcMainImpl instance exposed as the public ipcMain module.

nodes.label: BrowserWindow shim
nodes.desc: Patches the native BrowserWindow class prototype with loadURL, send, DevTools helpers and app-level focus forwarding.

nodes.label: webContents shim
nodes.desc: TS wrapper around the native electron_browser_web_contents binding; every renderer is reachable from here.

nodes.label: Renderer bootstrap
nodes.desc: Preload/renderer init: Module.wrapper patch, process.getProcessMemoryInfo, webPreferences and app path setup.

nodes.label: ipcRenderer re-export
nodes.desc: Two-line module: re-exports the native ipcRenderer from the electron_renderer_ipc linked binding.

nodes.label: contextBridge re-export
nodes.desc: Re-exports the native contextBridge binding used to expose APIs across isolated worlds.

nodes.label: ElectronApiIPC contract
nodes.desc: Mojo interface shared by both processes: Message, Invoke, MessageSync, ReceivePostMessage plus SerializedValue struct.

nodes.label: Native emitter (renderer)
nodes.desc: C++ gin wrappable that builds the ipcRenderer/ipcRendererInternal emitter objects and holds the mojo remote.

nodes.label: Frame handler (browser)
nodes.desc: Mojo receiver living per RenderFrameHost; turns incoming Message/Invoke into JS events on the browser side.

nodes.label: Dispatch to ipcMain JS
nodes.desc: Bridge that delivers deserialized payloads onto the ipcMain/ipcMainInternal JS emitters.
